title: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex falls 252 points, Nifty slips to 22,622, as rising crude, FII selling weigh on markets
summary: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: The stock markets closed in the red on Wednesday as investors booked profits following the previous session's sharp rebound, while rising crude oil prices amid geopolitical supply concerns and sustained foreign institutional investor (FII) selling weighed on market sentiment.
